subject: Private deployment - patch window & version pinning for AcmeOps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acmehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment - patch window & version pinning for AcmeOps

Hi Samir —

Following up from last week's call: we need to schedule a maintenance window to apply the Q3 security patches and a minor runtime bump to your private VPC bundle. Key asks up front:

- Target maintenance window: one 3-hour block (preferred) between 22:00-02:00 PT on a weekday (to align with your low-traffic period).
- Version pinning: we will pin the cluster to runtime v2.8.1 for 7 days post-deploy and only auto-roll forward after you give final signoff.
- Rollback: we will keep the previous pinned image available and maintain a KV-cache snapshot to restore within 30 minutes if needed.

Attached is a draft checklist (private-upgrade-checklist.pdf) and the ports/ACLs matrix (network-ports-matrix.csv) we'll need NetOps to validate.

Can you confirm a preferred day this week (or early next) and whether your NetOps team can validate the port lists? If you prefer a staged canary (10% traffic for 1 hour), we can run that too.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwood.ai)

--
Attachment: private-upgrade-checklist.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
Attachment: network-ports-matrix.csv (csv, 4KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - patch window & version pinning for AcmeOps

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and for the checklist. A few technical clarifications for Samir/NetOps before we lock the window:

1) Routing & drain: we'll perform a graceful connection drain on the inference shard, then rotate nodes one AZ at a time. That prevents KV cache inconsistency for running sessions.
2) KV snapshot: we'll snapshot the KV cache and the prefix cache prior to the first host reboot. Restoration path tested in staging: ~18 minutes to full restore, but we budget 30 minutes to be conservative.
3) Network ports: the CSV is accurate; only additional ask is a temporary egress to our telemetry collector (telemetry.redwood.ai:443) for 30 minutes post-upgrade to validate metrics stream.
4) Canary option: we prefer staged canary — 10% traffic at t0+15m, 50% at t0+45m, full at t0+90m — with explicit rollback gates at each step (errors >1.5% request error rate or latency p95 regression >200ms).

I'm attaching a shortened ops runbook excerpt to this thread for your NetOps folks (see private-upgrade-checklist.pdf). Olga, can you add the kernel/livepatch plan?

Laura Bennett
Principal Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Quick note on contractual/operational constraints:

- SLA window: per the Dedicated/Private contract SOW, we need to file a 72-hour advance maintenance notice for any scheduled rolling upgrade that may affect availability. Please confirm Samir receives an official notice by end of day.
- Credits: if rollback extends beyond the 30-minute restoration SLA for a single shard, the standard remediation credit applies; we should outline that in the notice so expectations are clear.
- On-call: this will require a 2-person on-call (Redwood infra + AcmeNetOps) for the duration + 1 hour post-window. Please ensure Acme's escalation contact is present.

I'll draft the notice once Jordan confirms the preferred date/time.

Aditya Rao
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan/Laura —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few items from AcmeNetOps:

- Preferred window: Thu 2025-07-24 22:30-01:30 PT (we prefer late Thursday to coordinate with our data ingestion lanes).
- Egress validation: we can allow telemetry.redwood.ai:443 for a 1-hour window post-deploy, but we'll require an allowlist entry tied to a short-lived cert.
- On-call escalation: I'll be on the call; primary NetOps engineer is Priya Sharma (priya.sharma@acmehealth.com). She will validate the port matrix by EOD 2025-07-18.

Also: we accept the proposed pinning for 7 days but request a mid-week status check (T+3) and an expedited rollback option to the previous image if we see any production regressions.

Samir Khan
